item.title: Nearly 1,500 Iranian civilians killed in U.S., Israeli strikes, report says
item.summary: The findings appear to be the most comprehensive estimates yet of the growing toll of dead and wounded civilians in the month-long war.

item.title: U.S. uses hundreds of Tomahawk missiles on Iran, alarming some at Pentagon
item.summary: More than 850 Tomahawks have been fired in just four weeks, people familiar with the matter said, alarming some Pentagon officials because the weapon’s supply is limited.

item.title: Pentagon considers diverting Ukraine military aid to the Middle East
item.summary: A shift would highlight the growing trade-offs required for the U.S. to sustain its war with Iran as the conflict depletes the military’s critical munitions.

item.title: Gulf countries want Trump to end Iran war — but not yet, officials say
item.summary: The Saudis and Emiratis fear a deal that leaves the region less stable, and they have indicated support for an escalated campaign to force concessions from Tehran.

item.title: Iraq accuses U.S. of killing 7 soldiers in clinic strike
item.summary: As Iraq claimed “heinous aggression,” the U.S. denied it targeted a clinic. The incident threatens to sour relations between the countries amid the Iran war.

item.title: U.S. plan to end war seeks removal of Iran’s enriched uranium, officials say
item.summary: The proposal offered sanctions relief to Iran in return for the removal of all its enriched uranium and other U.S. demands, officials said.

item.title: Trump says U.S. to hold off for 10 days on hitting Iran energy sites
item.summary: Trump’s statement follows an Iranian report that it had rejected a 15-point U.S. ceasefire proposal, a move that still left the door open for a counteroffer.

item.title: Cuba looks to Vatican for help as U.S. pressure plunges island into crisis
item.summary: Cuban officials have petitioned Pope Leo XIV to help persuade the Trump administration to ease its oil embargo, which is causing crippling fuel shortages and blackouts.

item.title: Far fewer immigrants are moving to big cities in U.S., data shows
item.summary: New York, Los Angeles and Chicago are among the metro areas seeing steep declines in net immigration amid the Trump administration’s crackdown.

item.title: China bars executives at Meta-owned AI company from leaving country
item.summary: Manus’s CEO and chief scientist are facing scrutiny from Beijing over the company’s $2 billion sale to Meta.
